scientific_integrity: Geometric lattice, Frobenius and deck matrices are credited to earlier publications; this report does not claim them as new. Self-review only; no independent scientific verification.
scientific_limitations: Arithmetic fixed-lattice discriminant-group computation derived using previously published complete Frobenius and intersection matrices. Priority risk: equivalents may be implicit in existing data or in unlocated publications; full discriminant quadratic forms and other diagonal forms not classified. Reproducibility uses exact integer Smith transformations.
title: Primitive arithmetic Picard lattices of the two quadratic Fermat-sextic double planes over \(\mathbb F_5\)
